newsitem.title: USA: Northstar launches international value fund.
newsitem.headline: Northstar launches international value fund.

text.p: NorthStar Investment Management Corp said it launched an international value fund to be managed by Brandes Investment Partners LP.
Charles Brandes and Jeffrey Busby of Brandes will co-manage the fund, which will seek long-term capital appreciation by investing in international equities.
NorthStar has about $2.5 billion in assets under management, and offers ten open-end funds and four variable annuity portfolios.
NorthStar is a unit of ReliaStar Financial Corp.
